target.statement: OUTPOST AUC-ROC on Photo under the validation rule (0.791 ± 0.048), the cheapest cell showing the paper's core claim that the selection rule changes the leader
target.table_ref: Table 1, Photo row, OUTPOST column under 'Best epoch on validation'

compute.basis: No code is linked, so OUTPOST (GraphSAGE + spherical k-means atlas + conformal pseudo-labeling + mixup/halo synthesis + SimSample) must be reimplemented from the text, then trained for 400 epochs x 10 seeds x multiple class rotations on Photo; CPU-feasible but the reimplementation and multi-seed protocol dominate the time.

blockers: No code or repository link anywhere in the paper (empty link list, no appendix URLs)
OUTPOST must be reimplemented from prose; many hyperparameters (K, alpha_r, lambda weights, warm-up W, margins) are only in an appendix not fully visible
Target is a mean over class rotations x 10 seeds, so many training runs are needed for a matching number
Exact split generator and seed-to-split mapping are not released, so the number cannot be matched exactly
title: The Selection Rule Decides the Winner: A Pre-Registered Audit of Open-Set Graph Anomaly Detection
